description: This file is a Bash shell script named size_compare.sh, used for comparing the sizes of locally compiled OpenWrt packages against upstream package indexes. It includes comments detailing its purpose, usage, and options, and contains functions for fetching package data, comparing sizes, and generating diffs in configuration. The script interacts with external tools like curl, wget, gzip, and standard Unix utilities to perform its tasks.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays script usage and help message by extracting specially formatted comments from the script itself.

methods.name: package_size
methods.description: Fetches the size of a package from upstream index, either installed size or package size based on environment variable.

methods.name: compare_sizes
methods.description: Compares local package sizes with upstream data, reporting differences and total size variance.
